Bayesian multilevel modeling for single-case experimental designs using [brms](https://paulbuerkner.com/brms/) and [Stan](https://mc-stan.org/). Fit piecewise regression models with random effects, compute posterior-based effect sizes, and assess consistency of effects across cases. Supports AB, reversal (ABAB), multiple baseline, multiple probe, alternating treatment, and changing criterion designs. Handles 2-level through 4+ level hierarchical structures for single-study and meta-analytic datasets.

## Installation

The development version from [GitHub](https://github.com/mshin77/scdbayes) with:

```r
install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("mshin77/scdbayes")
```

## Load the scdbayes Package

```r
library(scdbayes)
```

## Alternatively, Launch and Browse the Shiny App

Access the web app at https://www.scdbayes.org.

Launch and browse the app on the local computer:

```r
run_app()
```

## Getting Started

See the [Single-Case Design](https://mshin77.github.io/scdbayes/articles/single-case-design.html), [Meta-Analysis](https://mshin77.github.io/scdbayes/articles/meta-analysis.html), and [Power Analysis](https://mshin77.github.io/scdbayes/articles/power-analysis.html) articles.
